title: Late-Payment Points on Network and Server Order Deposits
content:
Late-payment points are added to the infrastructure deposit percentage, the percentage at which the deposit on the approval of a Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order quote is taken, from the ClearPath late fees posted on the client's ClearPath billing fewer than twelve whole months before the approval day: **10.0 points** for two or more such late fees, **5.0 points** for exactly one, and none when there is none.

The late fees counted are the late fee entries on the billing ledger of the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement.

| ClearPath late fees posted fewer than twelve whole months before the approval day | Points added |
|---|---|
| none | none |
| exactly 1 | 5.0 |
| 2 or more | 10.0 |

A late fee posted seven months before the approval day counts; one posted sixteen months before does not. Points are percentage points: 40 percent with 10.0 points added is 50 percent.
